title: Bleach Creator Returns With New Look at Aizen Ahead of Anime’s Finale
content: The exciting Fall 2026 anime season is right around the corner, which means fans will have to bid farewell to most of the Summer 2026 shows. This also includes Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity, the fourth part of the anime’s finale arc, which will wrap up the main story from the manga.
